value.Name: (un)Jaded
value.Description:
(un)Jaded is a mental health and service organization intended to destigmatize mental health and encourage social advocacy amongst the AAPI community. (un)Jaded recognizes the need for a culturally aware space that is committed to celebrating Asian identities, addressing intersectional issues, and promoting greater community involvement. Membership is open to self-identified Asians, Pacific Islanders, Asian Americans, and allies attending the University of Texas at Austin.

(un)Jaded will advocate for and educate on its values of...

  • Mental Health
  • Social Advocacy
  • Community Outreach

2026 Membership Update: If you're interested in joining, please visit @unjadedatx on Instagram to learn more! Sign up to join our mailing list, and we'll keep you updated once Recruitment begins. Please do NOT request to join the org through Hornslink.

Join us in Gearing 114 on Thursdays from 6-7pm.
value.Summary: (un)Jaded is a mental health and service organization intended to destigmatize mental health and encourage social advocacy amongst the AAPI community and its allies.

value.Name: 0fficial Pulse Club
value.Description:
0fficial Pulse Club (OPC) is UT Austin's first student-run fragrance organization.

 

  1. We make perfumes.
  2. We host scent exhibitions every semester.
  3. We host a monthly GM. (make candles, perfumes, aroma oils, etc.)

 

We welcome anyone seeking creativity, connection, and belonging. Come join us.
value.Summary: 0fficial Pulse Club (OPC) is UT Austin's first student-run perfume club. Anyone is welcome.

value.Name: 1967 Latina Run Club
value.Description: The 1967 Latina Run Club is a student-led organization at UT Austin that creates a safe and empowering environment for anyone interested in running, no matter their pace or experience. We host two runs each week: one “Hot Girl Walk” group for a more social, relaxed pace, and one faster-paced running group for those seeking more intensity. Beyond running, we host one to two socials each month and two philanthropy events each semester to give back to our UT and Austin community. We also love partnering with other Latino organizations on campus to strengthen connections and increase our sense of community. Our goal is to promote physical health, mental wellness, and belonging while giving students a supportive space to connect, stay active, and build friendships.
value.Summary: The 1967 Latina Run Club is a student-led organization that creates a safe, empowering space for runners of all levels. We host weekly runs to promote health, community, and wellness.

value.Name: 2400 Nueces Residence Hall Council
value.Description: 2400 Nueces Residence Hall Council (RHC) is a student-led organization that represents the residents of a specific residence hall. The council works to foster a sense of community, enhance the on-campus living experience, and advocate for student needs.
value.Summary: 2400 Nueces Residence Hall Council (RHC) is a student-led organization that represents the residents of a specific residence hall. The council works to foster a sense of community, enhance the on-campus living experience, and advocate for student needs.

value.Name: 360 Strategy Texas
value.Description: Grounded in the belief that human challenges require human-centered solutions, we combine design thinking principles, advanced AI models, and the diverse expertise of UT Austin students to deliver innovative and impactful consulting services. We offer consulting training through professor and professional lecture series for general members, and hands-on consulting work with analyst and officer members. We work directly with other student organizations, local businesses and non profit organizations. Our analysts are given the opportunity to be placed in 3 pillars: Business Strategy, Engineering, or Creative. In your team you will work with clients to deliver solutions for your client. If you are interested please join the GroupMe and fill out the interest form pinned in the group chat!
value.Summary: We are a pioneering consulting student organization focused on delivering projects to clients through a unique framework of understanding the root of the issue first: Design Thinking.

value.Name: 725 Dream at the University of Texas at Austin
value.Description: 725 Dream at UT Austin is a student-led chapter dedicated to increasing accessibility to U.S. citizenship. Rooted in the belief that financial barriers should never stand in the way of opportunity, we work to support and empower aspiring citizens through advocacy, outreach, and community partnerships. The chapter connects students with meaningful service and engagement opportunities, builds collaborations with local law firms and organizations, and raises awareness on campus about immigration issues. By mobilizing resources, knowledge, and compassion, 725 Dream at UT Austin seeks to create a stronger, more inclusive community where every aspiring citizen has the tools and support to achieve their dream.
value.Summary: 725 Dream at UT Austin increases accessibility to U.S. citizenship by providing advocacy, outreach, and partnerships that empower aspiring citizens and expand opportunities in our community.

value.Name: Absolute Pitch
value.Description: We are Absolute Pitch! Established in the Fall of 2018, we are one of UT's treble acappella groups. Our mission is to uplift individuals around us with our voices and presence on campus. If you have any questions about our organization, don't hesitate to contact us via email or Instagram!
value.Summary: Absolute Pitch is a treble acappella group that sings and performs a wide range of genres and music styles.

value.Name: Absolute Texxas
value.Description:
Absolute Texxas is dedicated to developing individuals based upon the principles of individual leadership, personal integrity, and teamwork. We are committed to fostering life-long friendships and personal development that will enrich our lives and craft a truly lifelong Absolute Texxas experience. If you are interested in joining us and/or would like more information, follow our main Instagram @absolutetexxas!

Recruitment Teaser
value.Summary: Absolute Texxas is dedicated to developing individuals based upon the principles of individual leadership, personal integrity, and teamwork. We are committed to fostering life-long friendships and personal development that will enrich our lives and cra…

value.Name: Acacia Fraternity at the University of Texas at Austin
value.Description:
The motto of Acacia is Human Service. What that means is that we encourage every member from pledge to active to try and make a difference in the community. We welcome new ideas, events, and plans whether that be helping at the food bank, raising money for charities, or hosting toy drives. We value the interests of our members and try to come together as a unified group to help make change. That said,  aside from what we do in the community, we also try and build lifelong friendships and brotherhood. Whether that be watching a football game, playing pool, or hitting up Top Golf, we put just as much into our members as we do the community. 

So if you can see yourself as a future Acacian or have any questions fill out our interest form below!
value.Summary: Acacia is a men's fraternity that aims to change the stereotypes placed on fraternities. Our motto: Human Service, embodies who we are and what we do. We place an emphasis on helping the community while also focusing on creating a lifelong brotherhood.

value.Name: Academic Counselors Association
value.Summary: Staff organization. Our goal is to build recognition of the importance of effective academic advising and enhance the professional development of advisors.

value.Name: Academy of Managed Care Pharmacy at UT Austin
value.Description: AMCP is a national professional society dedicated to the practice of pharmacy in managed care. Its goal is to lead the way in helping patients get the medication they need at a cost they can afford while promoting the development and application of pharmaceutical care.
value.Summary: AMCP is a national professional society dedicated to the practice of pharmacy in managed health environment and to promote the development and application of pharmaceutical care.

value.Name: Access Christian Fellowship
value.Description: Access Christian Fellowship is the college ministry for Harvest Mission Community Church of Austin (austin.hmcc.net). Our vision is to see people’s lives transformed, redirected to God’s purposes, and sent out to transform the world for the glory of God. We believe college is a pivotal time for people to discover their God-given destiny, and no matter your cultural background, field of study, profession, or stage of life, we believe that the transforming power of God can be experienced through our community here
value.Summary: For UT students to develop personal and life-transforming relationships with Jesus Christ, who will then go and spread the Gospel so others may experience the love of Christ.

value.Name: ACEing Autism
value.Summary: ACEing Autism is a nonprofit that helps children with autism learn and enjoy tennis. The program offers weekly sessions run by trained volunteers, giving kids a fun way to build coordination, socialize, and feel more confident on the court.

value.Name: Active Minds at The University of Texas at Austin
value.Description: Active Minds is the nation's premier nonprofit organization promoting mental health for young adults. Through education, research, advocacy, and a focus on young adults, Active Minds is opening up the conversation about mental health and creating lasting change in the way mental health is talked about, cared for, and valued in the United States.
value.Summary: Dedicated to building stronger communities through education, research, advocacy, and a focus on young adults, Active Minds is opening up the conversation about mental health and creating lasting change in the way mental health is talked about.

value.Name: Acts College Fellowship
value.Description: We are one of many Christian ministries (organization) on campus, but one of very few "church based" college ministries on UT campus. ACF is part of a church in Austin called "ACTS" in which we strive to follow the 3 Greats: the Great Commandment, the Great Community, and the Great Commission. As a Christian ministry at UT, we exist to proclaim the Gospel of Jesus Christ, to raise up genuine followers of Christ, and to make Christ known on our campus and beyond. We are a group that genuinely loves God and desires to make progress in becoming more like Jesus.
value.Summary: Christians that gather together to worship and have fellowship in Jesus Christ.

value.Name: Actuarial Science Club
value.Description:
The Actuarial Science Club at the University of Texas at Austin was established with the goal of enhancing opportunities for students interested in actuarial science. The club provides resources for these students to aid them in pursuing internships and full time jobs, preparing for actuarial exams, studying for their actuarial classes, and developing a social and professional network. 

Email us for the latest information!
value.Summary: Enhance opportunities for social interaction for students who are interested in actuarial science. All members gain experience and knowledge of the actuary field, its past, and its future.

value.Name: Adavu Club
value.Description:
Adavu Club is a space for Bharatanatyam dancers to be able to pursue and continue their passion for dance in a non-competitive setting. Through choreographing pieces and strengthening their skills, we hope to support a new generation of dancers in nurturing their relationship with Bharatanatyam in an inclusive, non-competitive environment. General workshops will be held every other week. In these workshops, we will give members the opportunity to try choreography, explore their abhinaya, and strengthen their nritta.

We welcome Bharatnatyam dancers of all levels to come and dance with us!
value.Summary: Adavu Club is a non-competitive Bharatanatyam club. Workshops are held biweekly where we explore choreography, nritta, and abhinaya.

value.Name: Aerial Solutions for Combatting Emergencies and Natural Disasters
value.Summary: We are a project-based organization focused on developing a cutting-edge UAV for international competition. Currently we are involved in GoAERO and XPrize Wildfire with our innovative all-terrain soft winged vehicle.

value.Name: Aerospace Engineering & Engineering Mechanics Graduate Organization
value.Description: The Aerospace Engineering & Engineering Mechanics Graduate Organization (AEMGO) connects ASE/EM graduate students through social events and an online community for discussing coursework, research, qualifying exams, life in Austin, and, of course, memes.
value.Summary: AEMGO seeks to encourage community-building opportunities for current and prospective graduate students in the Aerospace Engineering & Engineering Mechanics department at UT Austin.

value.Name: Afterglow ATX
value.Description: Afterglow is the premier digital and print music publication of the University of Texas at Austin. Produced entirely by students, our mission is to publish innovative work with a special focus on topical stories that push boundaries on how we view different artists, genres, and trends. We foster a distinct creative community with our robust daily digital content, long-form print magazine publishing, new media production, and public engagement through immersive concerts and events.
value.Summary: We are an online music publication with a mission to publish innovative work and spotlight underrepresented artists' work.

value.Name: AIESEC in Austin
value.Description:
AIESEC is an international, student-run non-profit that operates as a hybrid between a not-for-profit organization and a student organization. Members build professional skills through delivering AIESEC's global exchange programs to UT students and corporations based in Austin. Through developing business skills and understanding the world more, AIESEC develops young leaders who are solution-oriented, self-aware, world-citizens, and who empower others to be the same.

 

Join if you are interested in:

 – Leadership development

 – Networking with professionals globally

 – Making an impact in our community

 – Cross-cultural awareness

 – Gaining practical business skills, such as in B2B and B2C sales, marketing, and finance

 

 

Ready to apply? Apply to join today at aiesecus.org/join (please copy and paste the URL in your browser if the link is not working). Contact vptm-austin@aiesecus.org for more information on membership! Students from all disciplines and majors are welcome.

 

Info Sessions:

– Tuesday 9/8 from 6:00-7:00 PM in African American Culture Room of the Texas Union

 – Wednesday 9/23 from 5:00-6:00 PM virtually

 

Or join us at our open LCM

 – Monday 9/21 from 6-7 PM in room 3.112 in the William Powers Center

 

Meet the officers on September 14th at Lime Green!

 

 

Believe in Leadership, Make an Impact. Join AIESEC today
value.Summary: We are the world's largest youth-led non-profit organization. Our mission is to provide youth with challenging, cross-cultural experiences so they may activate their leadership through a professional business setting and understand the world better

value.Name: Alchemind Texas
value.Description:
Alchemind brings together students passionate about psychiatry and neuroscience, fostering a close-knit community dedicated to destigmatizing addiction and mental health disorders. What sets us apart is our vibrant community culture, where members collaborate to educate both students and the public on cognitive development and often misunderstood topics in addiction and mental health. Through interactive seminars, expert guest panels, and community service, we actively engage with these critical issues while integrating essential resources on campus for UT students. Alchemind isn’t just a group; it’s a united community where ambitious individuals connect with one another through intimate events such as socials, peer mentorships, and networking opportunities. Together, we create a supportive environment that shares a passion for these sciences and takes meaningful action to address misrepresentation in the field.

Our community emphasizes cognitive development/wellness and psychiatry/destigmatization. The former primarily focuses on teaching members and the public how to scientifically keep their mind healthy. The latter strives to educate students on the complexities and correlations between addiction and mental illness, working to accurately reverse issues that are often misrepresented.
value.Summary: Alchemind unites students passionate about psychiatry and neuroscience, working to destigmatize addiction and mental health. Our workshops, peer mentorships, and networking events, create a vibrant community culture that builds long term connections.

value.Name: Allied Scholars for Animal Protection at The University of Texas at Austin
value.Description: Allied Scholars for Animal Protection (ASAP) is a student organization that educates, trains, and mobilizes student advocates in the field of animal protection. We provide the infrastructure, organization, and resources that enable students to effectively advocate for human and nonhuman animals alike.  To become a member and staying up to date on events and meetings, please fill this form here: alliedscholars.link/utaustin
value.Summary: Allied Scholars for Animal Protection (ASAP) is a student organization that educates, trains, and mobilizes student advocates in the field of animal protection. We help students effectively advocate for animals.

value.Name: Alpha Chi Omega
value.Description: The Alpha Chi Omega Fraternity is devoted to enriching the lives of members through lifetime opportunities of friendship, leadership, learning and service. The main purpose shall be to encourage the spirit of true sisterhood, to develop through personal high moral and mental standards and to advance the appreciation and practice of allied arts among its members.
value.Summary: The Alpha Chi Omega Fraternity is devoted to enriching the lives of members through lifetime opportunities of friendship, leadership, learning and service.

value.Name: Alpha Kappa Psi - Prof. Bus. Frat.
value.Description: Alpha Kappa Psi is the world's oldest and largest professional co-ed business fraternity spanning across all careers and backgrounds. We pride ourselves on our three pillars: Professional, Philanthropy, and Brotherhood. As a member, you will make your best friends at the University of Texas, while being provided with an incredible opportunity to develop professionally. Additionally, we have a vast network of alumni and brothers who are able to provide guidance, advice, and even job opportunities. While currently around 70% business students, AKPsi is open to all majors.
value.Summary: Alpha Kappa Psi is the world's oldest and largest professional co-ed business fraternity spanning across all careers and backgrounds. We pride ourselves on our three pillars: Professional, Philanthropy, and Brotherhood. We are open to all majors.

value.Name: American Association of Drilling Engineers
value.Description: The American Association of Drilling Engineers (AADE) at The University of Texas at Austin is dedicated to advancing education in drilling engineering and fostering technical knowledge related to the petroleum industry.
value.Summary: The dissemination of knowledge of the theory and practice of all aspects of drilling engineering and the furtherance of the professional development of the student member....

value.Name: ATX KDC
value.Description:
Hi, we are ATX KDC! We are a dance crew founded to promote K-pop culture and modern dance styles at UT Austin. You can catch us performing at on and off-campus events, filming covers for our YouTube channel, and sharing our love of K-pop and modern dance with Austin and beyond.

Check out our YouTube channel to see more of what we do! 

youtube.com/c/ATXKDC

Follow us on our social media linked below!
value.Summary: Organization that showcases the mixture of Korean pop culture and American hip hop culture through dance.

value.Name: Austin Students for a Democratic Society
value.Description: Austin Students for a Democratic Society (SDS) is a multi-issue, student-based activist group organizing to make progressive change on campus. We focus primarily on activism based around social issues rather than elections, leading campaigns for the rights of all students!
value.Summary: Austin Students for a Democratic Society (SDS) is a multi-issue based activist group organizing to make progressive change on campus. We focus on activism based around social issues rather than elections, leading campaigns for the rights of students!

value.Name: Blanton Museum of Art
value.Description:
The Blanton Museum of Art at The University of Texas at Austin is one of the foremost university art museums in the country, and has the largest and most comprehensive collection of art in Central Texas. The Blanton's permanent collection of more than 17,000 works is recognized for its European paintings, an encyclopedic collection of prints and drawings, and modern and contemporary American and Latin American art.

The Blanton is considered one of the university's many Gems along with The Harry Ransom Center, the Briscoe Center for American History, The University of Texas Press, UT Libraries, the Graduate School, and the Michener Center for Writers. 

Located at the intersection of Martin Luther King Jr. Boulevard and Congress Avenue, the museum is across the street from the Bob Bullock Texas State History Museum and is adjacent to downtown Austin.
value.Summary: We're one of the foremost university art museums in the U.S. and have the largest collection of art in Central Texas. Current UT faculty/students/staff always receive free admission.  Curiosity welcome!

value.Name: Brazilian Jiu Jitsu at the University of Texas
value.Description:
UTBJJ is the official RecSports sponsored Brazilian Jiu Jitsu organization at UT Austin. We are both a recreational and competitive club and welcome those wanting to learn self defense and those who wish to compete locally. Beginners are always welcome, no experience is needed! Everyone gets 4 free practices so if you have any interest, make sure to check us out. We hope to see you on the mats!

 

Practice Schedule:

-Thursday 5-7 PM (Gi)

- Friday 4-6 PM (No-Gi)

- Sunday 1-3 PM (No-Gi)

 

At the RecCenter in room RSC 1.138

(After entering, walk straight until you hit the back wall; look left, and the room will be there)

 

Instagram: @heelhookem

Website: utbjj.org

Please check out our Guide to UTBJJ for more info about the club and how to join.
value.Summary:
UT BJJ is a great place to learn and compete in a growing and emerging self-defense sport while being part of a great community. Beginners are always welcome. We hope to see you on the mats!!

Check out our Instagram for the latest updates! @heelhookem

value.Name: Campus Elections
value.Description:
The Campus Elections group is a temporary organization available to all candidates for use during the First-Year Elections and Campus-Wide Elections campaign seasons. Membership is limited to eligible candidates who have filed with the Office of the Dean of Students to run in the respective election. It is currently active for the Fall 2026 First-Year Election.


To be added to the Campus Elections organization, each candidate must:

  1. File to be a candidate for the First-Year Election. Filing opens Friday, August 21, 2026, at 9:00 a.m. and closes Monday, September 14, 2026, at 9:00 a.m.
  2. Create a HornsLink profile (the candidate representative must create a profile as well).
  3. Complete the Campaign Organization and Protected Marks Agreement (candidate only; opens August 21, 2026).
  4. Request to join the "Campus Elections" student organization. Candidates must request to join as "candidate," and the Candidate's Authorized Agent must request to join as "campaign staff."
  5. Attend the Candidate Seminar as specified in the election timeline (Monday, September 14, at 6:00 p.m. in WCP 2.302).

    Removal: Candidates who do not attend the Candidate Seminar, withdraw from the election, or are disqualified from the election will be removed from the Campus Elections student organization.
value.Summary: Temporary organization available for use by candidates participating in first-year and campus-wide elections during the election campaign season.

value.Name: Club Golf
value.Description: Club Golf aims to bring golfers at UT together. This is through meeting people to play golf with, playing Club Golf tournaments hosted by the NCCGA, and also by hosting our own events.
value.Summary: Longhorn Golf Club unites UT student golfers not pursuing collegiate golf for both recreational enjoyment and competition. We foster a supportive, inclusive community, enabling members to continue their passion for golf.

value.Name: College of Fine Arts
value.Description: The College of Fine Arts at The University of Texas at Austin prepares students for the creation, practice, study, criticism and teaching of the arts, in a context that emphasizes cultural diversity, community engagement and technical innovation. It includes the Butler School of Music, Department of Art and Art History, and Department of Theatre and Dance.
value.Summary: College of Fine Arts

value.Name: Engineering and Computational Learning of Artificial Intelligence in Robotics
value.Description:
ECLAIR is dedicated to helping all robot-loving and passionate AI students transform their unique ideas into reality. We provide the robotics parts, membership, training, and community to give students everything they need to succeed. Members will learn about many aspects of robotics and AI and become a part of one of the most open-minded and supportive groups on campus. We believe robotics should be accessible to everyone, so any major can join, any skill level can join, and you're never expected to pay a single cent of your own money. If you have a cool robotics project you want to build, come join us! You can apply to lead a project every semester, and we'll cover every cost you might incur along the way. You can join our Discord here!

Note: We do not use Hornslink as our primary communication method. Instead, please join our Discord and follow our Instagram to stay up to date on all things ECLAIR.
value.Summary: Engineering and Computational Learning of Artificial Intelligence in Robotics (ECLAIR) is a CS organization dedicated to helping students of all backgrounds transform their robotics and AI ideas into reality through student-led projects funded by ECLAIR

value.Name: First-Gen Longhorns
value.Description: Through the First-Gen Experience Program, First-Gen Living Learning Community, and campus-wide events, we provide meaningful support, engaging programming, and access to resources. Our office connects first-gen students to a strong community and helps them thrive throughout their college journey.
value.Summary: First-Gen Longhorns is committed to supporting and celebrating first-generation college students at UT Austin.

value.Name: IEEE Robotics and Automation Society
value.Description:
The IEEE Robotics & Automation Society at the University of Texas at Austin

Inspires robotics research and aspires to make robotics more accessible to persons of all backgrounds. Since 1997, from our primary residence in UT's Electrical and Computer Engineering department, we have connected undergraduate students from mechanical, electrical, aerospace, computer, and other engineering (and non-engineering) fields. We help students gain practical multi-disciplinary experience in the lab, then demonstrate our abilities at various robotics competitions while promoting robotics via community outreach.

 

Join our DISCORD to get connected!
Check out our LINKTREE for all resources!
See our WEBSITE for more information about RAS!
Stay updated on our MAIN INSTAGRAM for events!
Take a look at our SPAM INSTAGRAM for fun :)
value.Summary: A student org focused on robotics! We accept all majors and all levels of robotics experience. Check out our website at ras.ece.utexas.edu and https://linktr.ee/UT.RAS (our linktree) for updates!

value.Name: Student Governance Organizations
value.Description: Student Governance Organizations is an area within The Office of the Dean of Students. We assist with administrative, financial and programatic support of Student Government and the Senate of College Councils at the University of Texas at Austin.
value.Summary: Student Governance Organizations is an area within The Office of the Dean of Students.  We assist with administrative, financial and programatic support of Student Government and the Senate of College Councils.

value.Name: Texas Marine Robotics
value.Summary: Texas Marine Robotics (T.M.R.) is a UT student club building an autonomous surface vessel (ASV) for competition. We bring together engineers and programmers to learn, collaborate, and apply their skills to real-world robotics challenges on the water.

value.Name: Texas Robotics Graduate Students
value.Description:
We aim to foster community among graduate students and connect students to opportunities (tours of robotics companies, speaker series, socials, and more).

To join our email list, head here and search for TRGS and press subscribe.
value.Summary: A student org to promote community, opportunities, and professional development for graduate students in Texas Robotics.
